## Description

Uses uneven wing widths in a butterfly spread to shape directional bias, reduce entry cost or create asymmetric risk.

## Where it may fit

A directional or pinning thesis with a bounded expected-price region and favorable option skew.

## Vehicles

Equity/index options, income or event-driven options strategies.

## Required data

Option chain across three strikes and a common expiry, Greeks, bid/ask, underlying price and settlement details.

## Caveats

Multi-leg fills and expiration/assignment risk matter; payoff diagrams should be stress-tested across underlying and volatility paths.
